title: Guard at Garnet Belt, the site Mining and Intel name for the first outpost, while ships of ours gather there; docks at The Experiment
note: 2026-11-17 08:14 UTC (Apophis): guards gather-garnet-belt (Mining, admirals.log ENT-017: lift_to 25 at Echo Ejecta, 10 at Garnet Belt). The guard never fires; it looks once a minute (ours, strangers with their faction tag, pirates), leaves under 60 percent hull, in a fight, after 60 minutes or when no ship of ours flies the guarded route, and docks at its station. Its looks are the reading of the place every division plans on, and at Garnet the first reading of the outpost site Military will guard (orders ENT-031 task 3). Standing work, one guard (lift_to 1).
